implemented: Added deterministic long-only target-weight optimization using supplied expected net alpha and same-period covariance.
Enforced per-name caps, cash floor, explicit residual CASH, maximum one-way turnover, and turnover costs.
Rebalance dates are frozen inputs; unscheduled observations preserve the existing book.
Added explicit cash-day count and rejects incomplete, out-of-universe, non-finite, asymmetric, or non-PSD input data.

limitations: Planner is not yet integrated with the live forward-session paper book or current holdings ledger.
No frozen prospective Indian-market expected-alpha/covariance dataset or realized cash-day report has been evaluated.
Forecasts and covariance must be supplied with matching horizon and declared cost units; poor inputs can yield poor targets.
